method: Every snap the pipeline emitted on the two Madden clips was labeled. Down, distance, quarter, and yard line were read from RapidOCR tokens on the sampled frames (the scorebug ampersand is legible there) and checked against keyframes for the play-call screen, the penalty cards, the sack bug, and the touchdown banner. A field is null when those frames did not show it. Formation is null unless one formation was actually singled out; a menu that lists the whole tab is not a formation read. Coverage is labeled only from a PREVIOUS PLAY line. Result yards follow the next down's distance when that next down is on screen.

snaps.note: Play-call tooltip is HB Slam. The formation tab lists Bunch, Cluster, Clamp Stack, and others, so formation is unknown. Field numbers 37 and 48 have no own/opp. Next bug is 2nd & 10.
One frame, token 2ND810 at 1st 3:26. Next frame is 3rd & 10. Kept because the token is unambiguous.
3RD810 from 3:23 through 3:17. The next play-call screen says PREVIOUS PLAY COVER3BUZZMATCH. The following live bug is 1st & 10.
1ST810, then a TOUCHDOWN banner at 1st 2:39. The following defensive call screen says PREVIOUS PLAY COVER1CONTAIN. No play name was singled out.
Kickoff setup, 1st 2:39. The 35 on the field is a yard marker, not own/opp.
1ST810 at 1st 2:37. Next bug is 2nd & 10, distance unchanged.
2nd & 10. Penalty card: encroachment, decline keeps 2nd & 10 on own 35. That is the pre-penalty spot. Next down is 2nd & 5, so there is no play result.
2ND85 after the penalty accept (2nd & 5). Clock stays 2:36. The following 1st & 10 is Detroit's offense (Goff) with the penalty overlay still up, not a measured conversion of this down.
1ST810, Detroit on offense, clock still about 2:36 then 2:34. Clip ends before a result. Penalty and defensive menu text are on screen; they are not this snap's formation or coverage.
Opening kickoff, 1st 6:00. No formation or coverage on the kick.
1ST810 at 1st 5:57. The next bug is 1st & 15 after Illegal Man Downfield, so the play result is not a simple yard delta.
Penalty card accept line is 1st & 15 on own 22. Next live bug is 2nd & 14, so the snap gained 1.
3rd & 14. Next bug is 4th & 22 with a 1 SACK line (Nick Bosa). Eight yards lost. result_kind sack is the coach-side kind; the result column stores the yards.
4th & 22, 1st 5:06, 0-0, sack already counted on the previous snap. The 4th-down play's yards are not on a following down inside a clean one-play clock step.
1st & 10 at 1st 4:29. The decoded prefix ends here.
